decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm's core expertise in two-component spraying, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the product.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and was field-tested on a construction site, showing the firm has absorbed practical learning and can keep improving it.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the firm's proven air motors, a close fit with its existing knowledge base that keeps both risk and the cost of improvement low.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat further from the core pump technology, but it supports the application of fire protection coatings, is presented on a page of its own, and draws on the firm's knowledge of controlling material flow.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only recently and extends the firm's established two-component competence, so it deserves time to gather and assimilate market feedback.
